name: Sri Lanka

latest_census.notes: Census of Population and Housing 2024 -- already read by the repo from the DCS trilingual workbooks (A2 ethnicity, A3 religion by district; docs/SOURCES.md 'Sri Lanka, and a check the source hands you'). Language is not asked as mother tongue; the census asks literacy (ability to speak/read/write Sinhala, Tamil, English, aged 10+), which is overlapping proficiency rather than a composition, and the adapter already marks language NOT_COLLECTED for that reason (scripts/fetch_census/sri_lanka.py, line ~273). The packet's empty declared_not_collected looks like a packet-side omission rather than a gap in the data.

subnational_sources.title: Census of Population and Housing 2024 -- tables A2 (population by ethnicity and district) and A3 (population by religion and district); already built
subnational_sources.matches_boundary_level: admin2 (25/25 filled); admin1 provinces (9/9) summed from districts
subnational_sources.evidence: The repo reads these from data/raw/srilanka/ (docs/SOURCES.md).

subnational_sources.title: Census of Population and Housing 2012 -- population by ethnicity / by religion, by Divisional Secretariat (DS) division
subnational_sources.matches_boundary_level: neither: the boundary file stops at district (admin2 = 25)
subnational_sources.evidence: Recalled: DCS published 2012 ethnicity and religion by DS division (and Grama Niladhari division) as Excel/PDF tables on statistics.gov.lk. Only relevant if an admin3 layer is ever added; the 2024 round may carry the same.

tier_reason: The newest census in the dataset (2024) already fills religion and ethnicity at both drawn levels from DCS workbooks; language is a genuine not_collected with the reason recorded in the adapter.
recommended_action: Nothing to build. Confirm the packet generator picks up the adapter's language NOT_COLLECTED declaration (it exists in sri_lanka.py but the packet shows declared_not_collected as empty). If a DS-division layer is ever added, the 2012 (and possibly 2024) DS-division tables on statistics.gov.lk cover both fields.
not_found: Any mother-tongue count for Sri Lanka (the census does not ask one; only literacy in Sinhala/Tamil/English)
summary: Sri Lanka is done: the 2024 census tables A2/A3 already fill religion and ethnicity for all 25 districts and the 9 provinces summed from them. Language is not asked as a composition -- the census records literacy in three languages -- and the adapter declares it not_collected; the packet's empty declaration list should be checked against that. Tier A, already built; nothing replaces it.
